person_note: The diagnostic quotes repeatedly present Celeste, Karen, and Greer externally while reporting their private thoughts, matching commercial structural descriptions of shifting third-person viewpoints or an omniscient narrator. The apparent second person in q03056 is local romantic thought, the first person in q03068 is an embedded written message, and the remaining first-person forms occur in speech, gnomic material, or an unattributed fragment. No source indicates autonomous first- or second-person sections. Confidence is medium because the sustained prose sample and whole-book descriptions are Tier C, although varied interior Goodreads quotes consistently corroborate THIRD.
